headline: Committee to consider budget transfers for ARPA road and sidewalk funds, a domestic violence prosecutor, and fire department radio equipment.
summary: The committee will review two budget resolutions involving transfers and expenditures of city funds, and a request from the Fire Chief to fund replacement public safety radio equipment before December 2026.
items: Amending Resolution and Budget Authorizations for transfer and expenditure of $63,753.12 for CIP 712622 ARPA - Revenue Replacement - Roads and Sidewalks and CIP 810724 Part Time Planner
Amending Resolution and Budget Authorization for acceptance and expenditure of $30,000 for CIP C070040127 Domestic Violence Prosecutor
Communication from Ryan Cashin, Fire Chief, requesting funding to secure replacement public safety portable radio equipment before December 2026 (funding source needs to be identified if approved)
plain_text:
SPECIAL MEETING 
COMMITTEE ON COMMUNITY IMPROVEMENT 
October 20, 2026 at 5:30 PM 
Aldermanic Chambers, City Hall (3rd Floor) 
 
Members: Aldermen Burkush, Vincent, Barry, Goonan, Terrio 
 
AGENDA 
 
 
The Chairman calls the meeting to order. 
  
The Clerk calls the roll. 
  
1. Amending Resolution and Budget Authorizations providing for the transfer and 
expenditure of funds in the amount of $63,753.12 for CIP 712622 ARPA - 
Revenue Replacement - Roads and Sidewalks and CIP 810724 Part Time 
Planner. 
Gentlemen, what is your pleasure? 
    
2. Amending Resolution and Budget Authorization providing for the acceptance 
and expenditure of funds in the amount of $30,000 for CIP C070040127 
Domestic Violence Prosecutor. 
Gentlemen, what is your pleasure? 
    
3. Communication from Ryan Cashin, Fire Chief, requesting funding to secure 
replacement public safety portable radio equipment before December 2026. 
(Note: Should the Committee approve of this request, a funding source needs 
to be identified.) 
Gentlemen, what is your pleasure? 
    
If there is no further business, a motion is in order to adjourn.
